text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer, ya got a quick sec?
choice_data_list: You sound really stuffed up... Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad, my bad.
Well, as you can see, I've got a terrible stuffy nose.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Nine times out of ten, the cause is the back-to-back races lately.
Like the fatigue just hasn't worn off yet.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I know we've got important races back-to-back.
But I'd really love to have a proper break somewhere in between.

Bubble Gum Fellow seems to have accumulated quite a bit of fatigue.
We should reconsider her race schedule...
